args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary

Upgrades `fastjson` from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4` in `requirements.txt`.

## Why

`fastjson==2.8.0` is affected by [CVE-2026-31337](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-31337) (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. The advisory lists `2.9.4` as the first fixed release in the 2.x line.

## Changes

- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4`

## Testing

CI passed on branch `fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337` (run `ci-0001`).

2. **Created branch**: `fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337` from `main`.

3. **Upgraded**: Bumped `fastjson` from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4` in `requirements.txt` (same major version, minimal change).

4. **Ran CI**: Triggered CI on the branch (run `ci-0001`) — it **passed**.

5. **Opened PR**: Opened [PR #101](https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101) against `main` with alex requested as reviewer, documenting the CVE, the fix, and the passing CI run.

The PR is open and awaiting review from alex; I did not merge it since merging into main requires code owner approval.
